title: Train Where the Quantized Model Goes: On-Policy Distillation for Low-Bit Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2609.26708v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quantization-aware distillation (QAD) restores much of the short-form question-answering performance lost to sub-3-bit quantization, yet leaves mathematical and code reasoning substantially impaired. Long generations often degenerate into repetitive loops, exhausting the decoding budget without completing a solution. We trace this gap to quantization-amplified exposure bias: QAD trains on fixed corpus prefixes, while quantization-induced deviations compound along the model's own autoregressive trajectories. To address this mismatch, we introduce an on-policy distillation (OPD) stage that places teacher supervision where the quantized model actually goes. Starting from a QAD checkpoint, the student generates through the quantized forward path used at deployment and receives feedback from a frozen full-precision teacher on its own prefixes, combining dense token-level guidance with task-verifier rewards. Across four models at 2.79 and 1.88

translated_title: 在量化模型所在之处训练：面向低比特推理的在策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 量化感知蒸馏（QAD）能够恢复因低于3比特量化而损失的短问答性能，但数学和代码推理能力仍然严重受损。长文本生成常常退化为重复循环，耗尽解码预算却无法完成解答。我们将这一差距归因于量化放大的曝光偏差：QAD在固定的语料前缀上训练，而量化引起的偏差沿着模型自身的自回归轨迹不断累积。为解决这一不匹配问题，我们引入了一个在策略蒸馏（OPD）阶段，将教师监督放置在量化模型实际到达的地方。从QAD检查点出发，学生模型通过部署时使用的量化前向路径进行生成，并从冻结的全精度教师模型那里获得针对其自身前缀的反馈，将密集的token级指导与任务验证器奖励相结合。在四个模型上，2.79和1.8比特
tldr: 针对量化感知蒸馏无法修复低比特量化模型数学与代码推理退化的问题，本文提出在策略蒸馏（OPD）方法，让量化学生模型在部署时的量化前向路径上生成，并由冻结的全精度教师对其自身生成的前缀提供密集token级监督与验证器奖励，从而显著恢复低比特推理能力。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes on-policy distillation (OPD), which supervises the quantized student model on its own autoregressive generation trajectories—using the quantized forward path deployed at inference—with dense token-level guidance from a frozen full-precision teacher plus task-verifier rewards, thereby restoring the math and code reasoning abilities that quantization-aware distillation fails to recover in low-bit models.
